{{Top|leg}}
'''Drokari''' was an indivual who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], working as a [[minister]] for the aristocrat [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Sargo VenHalgon]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Drokari joined VenHalgon on a vacation in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], staying aboard the luxury [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] ''[[Twilight's Kiss]]''. The ship landed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] and VenHalgon, Drockari and VenHalgon's other ministers went off on a hunting expedition. However, they were chased up a cliff by a [[Kilassin]], and were eventually rescued by [[Heroes of Cularin|the crew]] of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Starchaser IV]]''.<ref name="The Replacements">{{LivingForce|The Replacements}}</ref>
